text: Azer Abdullayev is a consultant orthopedic surgeon and head of department at King Fahad Hospital and Sabya Hospital in Jizan, Saudi Arabia, where he has worked since 2004. He studied at the Azerbaijan Medical University from 1972 and completed a surgery internship in 1979. He received the Candidate of Medical Sciences degree in 1989 and the Doctor of Medical Sciences degree in 2012. From 1979 to 1989 he was a traumatologist-orthopedist at the Sharur Central Hospital, and from 1989 to 2004 he worked in the Department of Traumatology and Orthopedics of the Azerbaijan Medical University. The CV describes six patents or inventor’s certificates, including an external fixation device, a compression pin, and an ointment.

Rauf Abdullayev is a database software administrator at proCtec GmbH in Aachen, where he has worked since January 2023. He holds a bachelor’s degree in computer engineering from the University of Duisburg-Essen (2015–2022); the thesis named in the CV is ManageData, a mobile application in Xamarin. From April 2015 to January 2023 he worked in front-office and IT support at Novum Hospitality AG in Düsseldorf, and in 2016 he completed an SQL database internship at Karttel GmbH in Neuss. The CV also lists earlier study and teaching-assistant work in Strasbourg and Baku.

Shuay Abdullayev is a postdoctoral research associate at the Complex Carbohydrate Research Center of the University of Georgia in Athens, Georgia, in the group of Prof. David Crich. He received a PhD in organic chemistry from the Université du Québec à Montréal in 2021 for a thesis on the synthesis of therapeutic glyconanomaterials, supervised by Prof. René Roy. He previously studied chemistry at Baku State University and at the Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1. His listed papers concern galectin ligands, sialylated oligosaccharides, neoglycolipids, and related carbohydrate chemistry. The CV states an h-index of 4.

Murad Abuzerli is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions postdoctoral fellow at the University of Vienna (2023–2026) on the NEOVITA project, supervised by Prof. Markus Aspelmeyer and Dr. Uroš Delić. He completed a PhD thesis in 2018–2022 at the Kastler Brossel Laboratory in Paris, supervised by Dr. Quentin Glorieux, on out-of-equilibrium dynamics in a paraxial fluid of light. He studied at ESPCI Paris, the Institut d’Optique, Paris-Saclay University, and Sorbonne University. The CV names a list of publications but does not print the references.

Emil Ahmadov is head of the Landau Department of Theoretical Physics at the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology and a leading researcher in that institute’s High Energy Physics Laboratory and at the Institute for Theoretical and Experimental Physics in Moscow. The CV dates a PhD defense to 11 April 1998 and a habilitation defense to 3 June 2009, without giving the institutions or thesis titles. From 2005 to 2020 he was a visiting professor or researcher at the Albert Einstein Institute in Golm, and in 2002 at KEK in Tsukuba. The CV lists state assignments and grants from the Basis foundation, the Dynasty foundation, and the President of the Russian Federation.

Radiation oncology. Thesis topics named in the CV: enhancement of radiation therapy for cervical cancer using personalized polyradiosensitization and interstitial adaptive brachytherapy; optimization of concurrent chemoradiotherapy for locally advanced uterine cervical cancer
Mathematics. The CV prints B.S.

Ismayil Aliyev is a professor at St. Petersburg State University of Economics, in the Department of Economics and Management of Enterprises and Industrial Complexes, since 2023. He graduated in labor economics in 1992 from St. Petersburg State University of Economics and Finance, later received the Candidate of Economic Sciences degree, and in 2007 defended a doctoral dissertation on incomes and living standards in the context of improving the social policy of the Russian Federation. He received the associate-professor title in 2002 and the professor title in 2009. The CV states more than 150 publications, including 12 textbooks and monographs, and supervision of 10 candidates of sciences and 2 doctors of sciences.
Completed theses at Hasan Kalyoncu University are listed in the CV

Aladdin Allahverdiyev is described as a professor and doctor. The CV lists him as a department head at the Fonon Research Institute of the USSR Ministry of the Electronics Industry; as professor, department head, dean, vice-rector, and first vice-rector at the Moscow State Academy of Business Administration; and as professor, head of education-quality, and deputy vice-rector at National Research University MIET. He is a graduate of the Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics of Lomonosov Moscow State University and of its postgraduate program. The CV states more than 450 works, inventions, monographs, and textbooks, supervision of 7 candidates of sciences, and more than 60 talks, including 12 invited plenary lectures.

Suleyman Allahverdiyev heads the Laboratory of Controlled Photobiosynthesis at the K. A. Timiryazev Institute of Plant Physiology in Moscow. He also holds professorships and laboratory posts in Pushchino, at Lomonosov Moscow State University, the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology, Bahçeşehir University in Istanbul, the Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnologies in Baku, al-Farabi Kazakh National University, and Foshan University. He graduated in physics from Azerbaijan State University in 1973, received the Candidate of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree in biophysics in 1984, and the Doctor of Sciences degree in plant physiology and biochemistry in 2002. The CV, dated June 2024, states more than 450 articles, 41 book chapters, 7 patents, and 13 monographs, with more than 30,000 citations and an h-index of 85. He was elected a corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences in 2022.

Elshad Allahyarov is a research professor of physics at Case Western Reserve University and holds concurrent research and professorial appointments at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf and at the Joint Institute for High Temperatures of the Russian Academy of Sciences. He received a Doctor of Sciences in physics and mathematics from the Russian Academy of Sciences in 2005. The thesis is The role of Coulomb correlations in colloids and biocolloids. The CV equates that degree with the German Dr. habil. He received a Doctor of Philosophy in physics from the Russian Academy of Sciences in 1994, which the CV equates with the German Dr. and the U.S. PhD, and a diploma in physics from Moscow State University in 1988. A German Research Foundation grant of 300,000 euro for 2021–2025 supports work on the actuation of composite elastomers.
Physics and mathematics. Thesis: The role of Coulomb correlations in colloids and biocolloids. The CV equates this with the German Dr. habil.
Physics. Thesis: Structure factor and effective interactions in non-ideal plasma and liquid metals. The CV equates this with the German Dr. and the U.S. PhD.
Thesis: Injection of relativistic electron beams into dense plasma. The CV calls this the U.S. equivalent of a Master of Arts in physics.

Mark Applebaum is an associate professor in the Department of Mathematics and Teaching Mathematics at Kaye Academic College of Education, a rank the CV spells Associated Professor and dates from 2018. He received an MSc from Azerbaijan State University named after Kirov in 1981–1986 and a PhD from Azerbaijan State Pedagogical University in 1996–2001. The dissertation is Teaching Mathematics using the idea of inquiry-based problems, supervised by Peter Samovol. He was a postdoctoral fellow with Roza Leikin at the University of Haifa in 2006–2007. He heads the MEd program in integrative STEM education and the Research and Evaluation Authority at Kaye.
The CV prints Associated Professor

Sevinj Asgerova is a professor and chief researcher at the N. I. Pirogov Russian National Research Medical University in Moscow. The CV gives her specialty as physician and ophthalmologist-surgeon. She defended a doctoral dissertation in 2005 at the S. N. Fyodorov Eye Microsurgery complex in Moscow. The CV states that she is the author of 18 invention patents, 15 rationalization proposals, and more than 140 scientific articles and abstracts, without listing them. It also names gold medals of Hippocrates and V. I. Vernadsky and the title Honored Worker of Science and Education.

Natig Atakishiyev is a researcher, with the rank Investigador Nacional Emérito, at the Institute of Mathematics of the National Autonomous University of Mexico in Cuernavaca, where he has worked since 1996. He received a diploma, described in the CV as equivalent to an MSc, from Azerbaijan State University in 1961, the Candidate of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree, described as equivalent to a PhD, from the Institute of High Energy Physics in Serpukhov in 1971, and the Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree from the Institute of Theoretical Physics in Kiev in 1987. From 1983 to 1994 he headed the Laboratory for the Theory of Elementary Particles at the Institute of Physics in Baku. The CV lists 131 journal papers and 62 conference papers, with 2,825 citations and an h-index of 28.
Candidate of physical and mathematical sciences. The CV states that this is equivalent to a PhD
Physics. The CV states that the diploma is equivalent to an MSc

Elchin Badalov is an associate professor in the Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery at Istanbul Aydın University, where he has been a faculty member since 2014 and received the associate-professor title in 2023. He graduated from the Faculty of Dentistry of Istanbul University in 2007 and completed a doctorate there in oral implantology in 2014. The thesis, as given in the English text of the CV, is a histological and histomorphometric study of vascular endothelial growth factor and early bone growth in a mouse model. The CV states more than 20 articles and book chapters in maxillofacial surgery and implantology, and two surgical techniques and a suture method that carry his surname, without naming them.

Ismihan Bayramoglu is a professor at Izmir University of Economics, where he has worked since 2001. He was dean of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences from 2001 to 2022 and chair of the Department of Mathematics from 2001 to 2015. He received a PhD from Kiev State University in 1988. The dissertation is on invariant confidence intervals and statistical criteria based on training samples. The CV lists a master’s degree and a BSc in applied mathematics from Azerbaijan State University in 1981. From 1993 to 2001 he was a professor in the Department of Statistics at Ankara University. Publications also use the spelling Bairamov.
Applied mathematics. The CV gives both labels for 1981
The CV lists courses taught in 1989–2024

Messoud Efendiyev is rector’s distinguished visiting professor at Marmara University in Istanbul and head of the Department of Dynamical Systems at Helmholtz Zentrum München, with a guest and leading professorship linked to the Technical University of Munich. He received a PhD from Lomonosov Moscow State University in 1980 and a Dr. Sci. (habilitation) from the Free University of Berlin in 1998. The CV lists 8 books and states that he is an author or coauthor of 186 journal and conference papers. His stated interests are infinite-dimensional dynamical systems, mathematical biology and medicine, and nonlinear equations of mathematical physics.

Lev Eppelbaum works in the Department of Geosciences at Tel Aviv University. He received an MSc in geophysics from Azerbaijan State University of Oil and Industry in 1982 and a PhD in geophysics in 1989 through the All-Union Geophysical Institute in Baku, the Institute of Geophysics of the Georgian Academy of Sciences in Tbilisi, and the Moscow Mining Academy. He completed postdoctoral studies at Tel Aviv University in 1991–1993 on interpretation and modeling of potential geophysical fields in the Dead Sea Rift. Since October 2020 he has been an honorary professor at Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University. The CV reports 7,192 Google Scholar citations and an h-index of 46. In 2018–2019 he received the Christian Huygens Medal of the European Geosciences Union.

Vahid Gadimov is a professor in the Department of Higher Mathematics and Programming at MIREA – Russian Technological University, and an acting professor at the Russian University of Transport. The CV gives a 1981 Promotion A (Dr. rer. nat.) on contact problems of plastic flow in a thin metal layer, and a 2000 Promotion B, described as a habilitation and Doctor of Science, on nonstationary contact problems of flow in a thin plastic layer. He was a senior researcher and professor at the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics in Baku from 1980 to 1997. The CV states more than 200 research publications and more than 45 textbooks, and lists 16 key works.

Khagani Gayibli is director of the Turkish Language Center at the University of Tartu, a post dated from 1998. He received a PhD in history from the University of Tartu in 2008–2011 and an MA in Uralic languages there in 2003–2005. He has been chair of the Estonia-Azerbaijan Society since 1994 and a member and deputy chair of the board of the Congress of World Azerbaijanis since 2001. The CV lists books of essays, poetry, and Turkish-Estonian language guides, and translations from Azerbaijani, Estonian, and Turkish. He was awarded the Taraggi Medal on 21 April 2022.

Mehdi Genceli is on the faculty of the Department of Turkish Language and Literature at the Institute of Turkic Studies of Marmara University in Istanbul. The CV heading gives the rank Doç. Dr., and the appointment line from 4 January 2012 describes him as yardımcı doçent. He received a doctorate at the same institute in 2002–2008 on the life, art, and works of the Azerbaijani poet Muhammad Hadi, supervised by Doç. Dr. Muhammet Gür, after a master’s degree there in 1999–2002 and a bachelor’s degree in Turkish language and literature at Marmara University in 1993–1999. He has been deputy director of the institute since 1 January 2018.

Zahid Gojayev is deputy director for innovation and implementation at the Federal Scientific Agroengineering Center VIM and a professor at Moscow Polytechnic University and Bauman Moscow State Technical University. He is a Doctor of Technical Sciences and a corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences, elected in 2019. He defended a Candidate of Technical Sciences dissertation at Bauman Moscow State Technical University in 1979 and a Doctor of Technical Sciences dissertation in 1994. From 2002 to 2014 he was general director of the Federal Research and Testing Center for Mechanical Engineering. The CV states more than 300 scientific works, monographs, and patents.

Arif Guliyev is a professor in the Department of Constitutional Law, International Law and Public-Law Subjects at the Kyiv University of Intellectual Property and Law of the National University Odesa Law Academy, and a member of its scientific council since 2021. In 2005 he received the Candidate of Sciences degree in public administration at the Academy of Public Administration under the President of Ukraine; the CV says this was recognized in Azerbaijan as Candidate of Legal Sciences. In 2012 he received the Doctor of Legal Sciences degree at the Institute of Legislation of the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine. The CV states 8 monographs, 3 textbooks, 2 teaching aids, more than 250 articles, 3 Scopus articles, and supervision of 25 candidates and 2 doctors of legal sciences.

Public administration. Thesis: features of the institution of the presidency in Ukraine and the Republic of Azerbaijan, a public-administration aspect. The CV says the degree was recognized in Azerbaijan as Candidate of Legal Sciences. Master’s and postgraduate study at the same academy are mentioned without separate years

Aynur Guliyeva is an associate professor at the University of Technology Tarbes Occitanie Pyrénées, where she has worked since January 2024. She received a PhD in chemistry of materials from the University of Orléans in 2016–2019, a Master 2 in polymers for advanced technologies from the University of Grenoble Alpes in 2015–2016, and a bachelor’s degree in chemistry from Baku State University in 2010–2014. She was a scientist at Lonza Capsugel in Colmar, a research engineer at PIMM, ENSAM in Paris, and a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Delaware. The CV lists 8 published articles.
Completed master’s theses at Kafkas University are listed in the CV

Reyhan Hasanova is a research consultant in real-world evidence at Oracle France in Paris, where she has worked since 6 April 2022, on oncology and rare diseases. She received a PhD in cellular biology from the University of Bourgogne Franche-Comté (2016–2019), with work on ANGPT2 in colorectal carcinoma, and an MD as a medical biologist from the Medical University of Azerbaijan (2007–2012). She also holds master’s degrees in endocrinology and metabolism from the University of Paris-Sud (2014–2015) and in cellular and molecular signaling from the University of Bourgogne Franche-Comté (2012–2014). The CV names one journal article, in the International Journal of Cancer (2020), with a DOI.
Cellular and molecular signaling (program title in the CV: Cellular and Molecular Signalisation)

Mehmet Riza Heyet teaches in the Department of Contemporary Turkic Dialects and Literatures at Ankara University, a post dated from 2013. He has been the concession holder and editor-in-chief of the journal Varliq since 2015 and head of the Tabriz Research Institute (TEBAREN) since 2016. He received a doctorate at Ankara University in 2021 on Mirza Mehdi Khan Astarabadi’s Sanglakh, and a master’s degree there in 2005. His bachelor’s studies in Azerbaijani language and literature were at N. Tusi Pedagogical University in 1993–1995 and Baku State University in 1995–1998. The CV lists selected books, articles, and talks on Iranian Turkic press, language, and identity.

Aygul Isayeva has worked in the Business Communications and PR department of SOCAR Energy Georgia in Tbilisi since January 2021. She was executive director of the Integration Center for Azerbaijanis of Georgia in 2018–2020 and an associate professor at Caucasus International University in 2016–2020. She received a Doctor of Business Administration, which the CV also calls a PhD, from International Black Sea University in 2011–2013, and an MSc in business and economics with a major in marketing from BI Norwegian Business School in 2006–2008. Her bachelor’s degree in international economic relations, with an honor diploma, is from Khazar University (2002–2006). Since September 2023 she has been enrolled in a Master of Science in Teaching and Learning at ADA University, with graduation expected in May 2025.
Business management and marketing. The CV also calls this degree a PhD

Togrul Ismayil is a professor. His history doctorate is from Lomonosov Moscow State University, and he also holds a doctorate in economics from Istanbul University. The CV does not give the years. His bachelor’s degree in history is from Lomonosov Moscow State University, and his master’s degree in social structure and social change is from Istanbul University. Supervised master’s theses are at Kahramanmaraş Sütçü İmam University and one is at TOBB University of Economics and Technology. His Russian score on the YDS examination is 93.75, listed as advanced.
The CV title is Prof. Dr. Supervised theses are at Kahramanmaraş Sütçü İmam University

Rasim Jannataliyev is a project manager for intelligent energy systems at EnBW AG in Stuttgart, where he has worked since June 2013. He holds a PhD from Azerbaijan Technical University (2004–2007); the CV also gives his title as Dr.-Ing. His thesis topic was the thermal properties of heat-transfer fluids for absorption refrigeration machines and heat pumps. Earlier he was a research assistant at the University of Rostock and at Azerbaijan Technical University, and a guest scientist at the Stuttgart University of Applied Sciences. The CV lists his languages as German, Azerbaijani, Turkish, and Russian, without proficiency levels.

Khalil Kalantar is a senior researcher and developer at Global Optical Solutions & Kepler. The CV states a bachelor’s degree in electronics engineering in 1980 and further degrees in Japan: a master’s in 1984 at Toyohashi University of Technology, a doctorate in 1987 at Nagoya University, and a doctorate in 2003 at Tohoku University. It also states a first PhD from Toyohashi University of Technology and a second from Tohoku University. Since 1995 his work has concerned optical devices for liquid-crystal displays, including light-guide plates. The CV states more than 96 articles, nearly 100 patents, three books in Japanese, and more than 15 book chapters.

Saadat Karimi is a senior lecturer and course manager at the University of Borås, with a permanent appointment from January 2021, and a university lecturer at the University of Gothenburg from January 2016. The CV heading gives the degree PhD. From 1993 to 1999 he was a doctoral student, and from 1996 to 1999 a senior researcher and lecturer, at the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences. He has also taught at the Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm and at Umeå University, where he was responsible for national mathematics tests. The CV lists books, chapters, and symposium papers, mostly on Azerbaijani history, literature, and education.

Sevda Karimova is a medical-law consultant at Vice Versa Consulting Ltd. She holds a bachelor’s degree in law from Nakhchivan State University (2009–2014), with an honors diploma, and a master’s degree in law, in transnational criminal law, from Baku State University (2014–2016). From 2017 to 2020 she was a doctoral candidate in bioethics and criminal law at the Institute of Law and Human Rights of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences; the CV says the thesis defense was transferred to Baku State University. The thesis subject is the bioethical aspects of the right to life and health in criminal law. She has taught bioethics and medical law and has worked at TABIB and at the Hacettepe University Center for Bioethics.

Saida Khalilova is founder and director of the Royal Conservatory of Music and Art in Muscat, a post dated from November 2023, and an associate professor at the Baku Music Academy, dated from October 2011. She received a PhD in music pedagogy from the Baku Music Academy in 2014 and a Master of Arts in music there in 1996. She taught piano at Sultan Qaboos University from 2011 to 2018 and at music colleges in Baku and Shusha. The CV lists a 2016 book and several papers on Elmira Aliyeva and piano education in Azerbaijan.
The CV prints the range 2021–2021
Named completed theses are in the CV, including work on Ali and Nino, Ilyas Efendiyev, and Azerbaijani proverbs

Agamali Mammadov is professor and head of the Department of Sociology of Communication Systems at the Faculty of Sociology of Lomonosov Moscow State University, where he has worked since September 2009. He graduated with honors from the Faculty of Philosophy of the same university in 1980, with a qualification in sociology, and also holds a qualification in law. He received the Doctor of Sociological Sciences degree in 1998 and the title of professor in 2000. The CV states an h-index of 44, more than 52 monographs and textbooks, and supervision of 25 candidates of sciences and 3 doctors of sciences.

Nizami Mammadov is a professor at the Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration in Moscow, where he has worked since 1995. He studied automation and computer engineering at the Azerbaijan Polytechnic Institute (1962–1967), received the Candidate of Philosophical Sciences degree in 1975, and defended a doctoral thesis at the Institute of Philosophy of the USSR Academy of Sciences in 1984. The Higher Attestation Commission of the USSR awarded him the title of professor in 1988. The CV gives 400 publications, an h-index of 33, and 41 candidates and doctors of sciences prepared.

Nigar Masumova is an associate professor in the Department of World Economy at MGIMO University in Moscow, head of the Department of Advertising and Public Relations, and deputy dean of the School of International Journalism. She received a PhD in economics at MGIMO in May 2012 and a specialist diploma in foreign economic relations there in June 2007. Her stated interests are the social and economic development of Turkey and Iran, and branding. The CV lists four main works, including a 2015 book on Turkey and contributions connected with volumes edited by A. Bulatov.

Gafar Mehdiyev is a professor at Erciyes University in Kayseri, in the Department of Armenian Language and Culture, a title he has held since 2016. He has been a faculty member there since 2010. He graduated from the Faculty of Journalism of Baku State University in 1980 and received a PhD in political sciences in 2007 for a dissertation on the role of the press in bringing out facts about the Armenian question, based on Armenian and Turkish press materials. He worked as a journalist and editor in Baku from 1980 to 2017 and taught at Baku State University from 2004 to 2012. The CV states more than 100 articles and about 20 books.

Emirullah Mehmedov is an emeritus professor and leading researcher at the Nanotechnology Research Center of Bilkent University, where he has worked since 2011. Publications use the name Amirullah M. Mamedov. He received a PhD in physics and mathematics from the Ioffe Institute in 1973. The thesis is on the optical and electro-optical properties of photoferroelectric materials and was carried out at the Vavilov State Optical Institute. He received the Doctor of Sciences in physics and mathematics in 1982 from the regional council in Riga, and the title of full professor of optics in 1988. The CV states more than 350 publications. He was scientific advisor to ASELSAN in 1992–2006.

Hajali Najafoglu is professor of inorganic chemistry at Kafkas University. His doctorate is in inorganic chemistry from the Azerbaijan Academy of Sciences. His master’s degree is in organic chemistry and his first degree is in chemistry, both from Azerbaijan State University. The CV does not give the years of those degrees. He was an assistant professor at Kafkas University in 1992–1995, an associate professor in 1995–1998, and a professor from 1998. Publications from the 1970s use the name G. N. Nadzhafov.
Named theses at Kafkas University are listed in the CV

Murad Omarov is vice-rector for international cooperation at Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics, a post he has held since 2015, and a professor there. He qualified as an electronic engineering engineer at the Kharkov Institute of Radio Electronics in 1980–1985. The CV describes a Candidate of Technical Sciences degree from postgraduate study in 1988–1991, and labels that thesis a PhD thesis, and a Doctor of Technical Sciences degree from doctoral study in 1999–2003. He has supervised four doctoral theses and teaches courses in communications, automation, robotics, and higher mathematics.

Candidate of technical sciences, information and measurement systems and networks. Thesis: research and development of new elements and devices of electronic equipment, and improvement of fiber-optic information transmission systems. Supervisor: Prof. I. Sh. Nevludov. The CV titles this a PhD thesis

Zarifa Osmanli is a postdoctoral fellow at BioComputing UP at the University of Padua, where she has worked since January 2024 on protein structure–function relations in cancer. She received a PhD in structural bioinformatics from the University of Montpellier and CRBM-CNRS in November 2019–December 2023, on bioinformatics tools for structural annotation of alternative proteomes. She holds an MSc in molecular biology from Ege University (2014–2017) and a BSc in biophysics from Baku State University (2009–2013). She is also a junior research assistant at the Institute of Biophysics in Baku, dated 2019–present in the CV.

Aliheydar Rahimov is a professor in the Department of Anesthesiology and Intensive Care at I. M. Sechenov First Moscow State Medical University, a post dated 2021 to the present. He has also headed the Department of Transfusiology at the Russian Scientific Center of Surgery named after B. V. Petrovsky since 1992. He graduated from the N. Narimanov Azerbaijan State Medical Institute in 1976, received the Candidate of Medical Sciences degree in 1980, the Doctor of Medical Sciences degree in 1988, and the title of professor in hematology and blood transfusion in 1993. The CV states more than 390 scientific works, including 18 monographs and 13 textbooks, supervision of 15 candidate and 6 doctoral dissertations, and 4 inventions.

Kamran Rustamov is scientific director of the Center for Modeling Political Communications in Moscow. The CV describes him as a doctor of technical sciences, professor, and Honored Science Worker of the Republic of Azerbaijan. It states scientific training in the United Kingdom in 1977–1978 and that he rose from assistant to head of department and defended candidate and doctoral dissertations. From 1991 to 1992 he was a state counselor to the President of Azerbaijan. The CV states more than 300 scientific works, monographs, textbooks, and articles.

Teymur Rzayev is a professor in the Department of Plastic Arts at Yeditepe University. His doctorate is from Azerbaijan State University of Fine Arts. The thesis is Pagan Sculpture of Azerbaijan, dated 2009, supervised by Telman Ibrahimov. His master’s thesis, Smena, was completed in 1988 at the Azerbaijan State Academy of Artists under Mikail Abdullayev. He has taught at Yeditepe University since 2006, as a lecturer until 2012 and as a doctoral lecturer in 2012–2014. The CV also lists associate-professor and professor ranks without separate start years.

Bakhtiyar Sirajov worked at the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) in Vienna from July 1995 until his retirement in November 2021. He was Team Leader of the Application Development Team from 2006 to 2021 and Section Head of the Application Development Section in 2020–2021, both at P5 grade. He holds a PhD in physics and mathematics. Postgraduate study is recorded as 1979–1986 at the Computer Center of the USSR Academy of Sciences in Moscow. The employment record states that the dissertation was submitted in 1990. He also worked at I-NET GmbH in Vienna and at the Institute of Cybernetics of the Azerbaijan Academy of Sciences.
Physics and mathematics. The employment record states that the dissertation was submitted in 1990. Seven published papers and conference participation are mentioned, without titles.

Ebulfez Suleymanov was head of the sociology department at Üsküdar University in Istanbul from January 2012 until August 2024. From November 2022 until August 2024 he was also at the International Turkic Academy in Astana. The CV gives his title as Prof. Dr. and does not name a doctorate. It states more than 150 scientific works, including 5 monographs, of which 12 articles are in Web of Science or Scopus journals, and more than 100 conference papers. Google Scholar figures in the CV are an h-index of 10 and an i10-index of 11.

Saleh Sultansoy is a professor at TOBB University of Economics and Technology in Ankara, where he has worked since 2007, and a leading researcher at the Institute of Physics of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences since 1993. He studied at Azerbaijan State University from 1969 to 1974 and received a doctorate in 1985 at the Institute of High Energy Physics in Serpukhov. His stated fields are high-energy physics, particle accelerators and their applications, science and technology strategy, and the history of science. The CV states more than 800 scientific publications, of which 632 are in Science Citation Index journals.

Khadija Zeynalova is an associate professor at the Detmold University of Music and artistic director of the Bridge of Sound orchestra and of the Harmony of Sound festival, which she founded in Germany. She studied music theory at Sumgayit Music College (1990–1994) and composition and musicology at the Baku Music Academy (1994–2000), and she continued composition studies in Detmold in 2005–2006. From 2006 to 2012 she was a doctoral student at the University of Paderborn; the thesis is on Azerbaijani musical culture of the 20th century and tendencies in Western music. From 2000 to 2005 she taught as an associate professor at the Azerbaijan State University of Culture and Arts. The CV states more than 40 books, works, and textbooks, without listing them.
